card.title: Step By Step Recipes With Me -No Bake Granola Bars

metadata.description: Dive into making No Bake Granola Bars with our easy step by step guide! Perfect for a healthy snack, these bars are customizable to be gluten-free, dairy-free, or peanut-free. You'll need a large mixing bowl or stand mixer, a spoon, measuring cups and spoons, and an 8x8 or 9x9 inch baking pan. Ingredients include peanut butter or a butter alternative, honey, vanilla extract, sea salt, oats, and optional add-ins like mini chocolate chips, nuts, or dried fruit.
